what: The parts sheet: every part of app/src/ui in every state and variant, at 390 wide. /dev/parts is light, /dev/parts?scheme=dark is dark. It is how a part is vetted, not a page a person sees.

states.shows: the wash, the nav and the top slot, then each part by section: decision cards (lead gradients, every state, batch, queue), item cards, notices, tags, counts and site badges, pills, foot buttons, guess, blank and approve, the amount, the toast, skeletons and the empty state, the setup slot, and the tab bar
the sheet over a scrim, with a guessed counter price and a send button

controls.control: A tab in the tab bar
controls.on_tap: moves the pill to that tab; nothing else moves
edits it in place; the typed value stays
logs the tap to the app log and globalThis.__events, and does nothing else
